messages.subject: New website deployed
parts:
As well as migrating the forums to Google Groups, today we have also upgraded our website.  It will have roughly the same content, but uses pkgdown to make it easier for the documentation to stay up-to-date.

There are some things that need to be smoothed (eg, broken relative links), but does anyone have reactions in the meantime?
